scope_outcomes.criterion: A retained row must show, in the citing text, a specific interpretive move that uses, reads, qualifies, contrasts, or reframes Max Weber, supported by a verbatim anchor.
scope_outcomes.basis: The complete supplied two-page source was inspected. It explicitly contrasts Marx’s and Weber’s standpoints, assigns Weber a firm-and-capital-owner perspective, distinguishes Weber’s and Marx’s uses of wage labour, and presents Lukács’s immediacy/mediation reading of Weber.
limitations: This outcome concerns only the supplied source and passage_reading dimension, not Riley’s complete work or the entire reception of Weber.
The source does not identify the specific Weber editions or passages behind Riley’s reconstruction.
